summary: In this excerpt from a fiction novel, detective Arturo is confronted by a Social Harmony official who hints that Eurasian electronics are designed by defected UNATS Robotics engineers, pointedly implicating Arturo's ex-wife, the highest-ranking UNATS technician to defect. Arturo, unnerved by her work surrounding him, including a robot toy she gave him that died within 48 hours, plays along. He then tries repeatedly to reach his robot R Peed Robbert, who stops answering, drives through autumn rain toward Sheppard and Don Mills, and sends R Peed Froderick to locate Robbert at the Fairview Mall area.
one_line: A Toronto detective, troubled by his defected ex-wife's robotics work, races through rain to locate his unresponsive robot R Peed Robbert.
key_facts: Arturo is a detective who is carrying a personal computer while speaking with a man from Social Harmony.
The Social Harmony man claims the Eurasians use defected UNATS Robotics engineers and scientists to design electronics for maximum interoperability with UNATS Robotics equipment.
Arturo's ex-wife was the highest-ranking UNATS technician to go over to Eurasia.
Arturo's ex-wife is thousands of kilometers away but her handiwork surrounds him.
Arturo's ex-wife gave him a robot toy for their second date, and it died within 48 hours of being given to him.
Arturo says he is monitoring a tail from an R Peed unit when the Social Harmony man asks about his work.
Arturo phoned R Peed Robbert the moment he reached his desk, and the phone rang three times before disconnecting.
Toronto is the Fourth Prefecture in the new metric scheme.
A light autumn rain had ended the Indian summer Toronto had been enjoying.
The UNATS Robotics chauffeur is skittish about driving fast on the Don Valley Parkway because of the wet roads.
Arturo put out a general call for robots in the area around Sheppard and Don Mills.
Arturo sent R Peed Froderick, located in the Fairview Mall parking lot, third level, to find Robbert.
Robbert's locator beacon is close by at the other end of the mall, near the Don Valley Parkway exit.
Arturo switched to a view from Froderick's electric eyes but quickly switched away, nauseated by the robot's spins and leaps.
